# Font fixture

`Abel-Regular.ttf` is the unmodified Abel font from the
[Google Fonts Abel directory](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/abel),
downloaded 2026-09-12. Its [SIL Open Font License](OFL.txt) is retained here.
It supplies a portable real outline font for geometry, CLI and MCP tests; it is
not an implicit font choice for a maker's part.

SHA-256: `8809dcad25318225052f88333e208c5aad4adcb7b2c934c135735ec19aa410b4`.
